name: Aries Reasoning
description: Defines deterministic Aries modifier resolution and forbidden inferences.

resolutionOrder: Load the target object and canonical function.
Confirm that Aries is operating as a modifier.
Load Aries semantic domains and components.
Reject incompatible pace, autonomy, or urgency language.
Select no more than one component per modifier slot unless stacking is explicitly allowed.
Return the Aries modifier set to the clause builder.
Validate that the target function remains unchanged.
Validate that no finished interpretation was introduced by the Aries layer.

defaultInferenceProfile.neutralPriority: with emphasis on the first actionable step
defaultInferenceProfile.paceRule: Use accelerated pace only when compatible with the target function.
defaultInferenceProfile.autonomyRule: Render autonomy as self-positioned agency, not isolation.
defaultInferenceProfile.developmentRule: Use healthy wording by default when a developmental stage is required but unspecified.

heuristics.rule: Prefer autonomous engagement over selfishness or isolation.
Prefer proportionate urgency over indiscriminate speed.
When the target function requires consolidation, discernment, reciprocity, or consent, suppress incompatible rapid-pacing components.
When defensive evidence is absent, suppress reactive, premature, forced, or oppositional modifiers.
When integrated evidence is absent, suppress precise-timing and context-aware integration claims.
Return an empty Aries modifier slot rather than inventing a semantically adjacent component.

planet: Modify only manner, strategy, pace, orientation, priority, regulation, or development.
Do not infer aggression merely because the planet is Mars.
Do not infer courage, conflict, leadership, or success.
angle: Preserve the angle's canonical reference-frame verb.
Modify how the reference frame establishes entry, relation, actualization, or rooting.
Retain the opposite-angle axis in reasoning.
Do not turn the angle into an actor.
node: Modify how consolidation or development proceeds.
Do not convert initiation into destiny or inevitability.
chiron: Preserve adaptation as the target function.
Use bounded testing rather than reckless exposure.
Do not equate immediate movement with cure.

forbiddenInferences: Aries replaces the target object's canonical function.
Aries alone determines personality or outcome.
Aries is inherently healthy, unhealthy, mature, or immature.
